card.name: Gaps before dose numbers and section refs
card.fires_on: Marks a spot just before a number: an opening parenthesis after 'Description' in section cross-references, or a space before a strength like 120 mg. Also fires on a few other words that precede a noun or number.

modes.label: Description cross-reference
modes.description: The opening parenthesis after 'Description' in a bracketed pointer to section 11.

modes.label: Space before a strength
modes.description: The blank space just before a milligram amount in dosing text.

modes.label: Other scattered words
modes.description: A stray word such as 'vaccine' or 'another' before a noun or phrase.
